spark_open.description: The creature is a quadruped shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of sandy, pebbly ground. It has the overall size, posture, fur, head, hind limbs and tail of a gray wolf, but its back, neck and crown are covered by a dark, glossy, segmented crustacean-like carapace, and its two front limbs end not in paws but in large, dark crab-like pincers that rest on the ground. The fur is dense and shaggy, gray with lighter underparts, and the shell is blackish-gray with overlapping segments and scalloped, slightly spiky edges.

parts.where: under the body, two in front under the chest and two in back under the hips, supporting the body in a standing pose

parts.looks_like: hind feet are wolf paws with toes, dark nails and pads; front feet are large, glossy, dark gray-black chelae with two curved, pointed pincers each and small bumpy textures at the base where they join the fur
parts.where: at the bottom of each leg; hind paws on the ground at the rear, front pincers touching the ground at the front

parts.where: at the rear of the body, extending down and slightly outward from the base of the back

parts.looks_like: individual overlapping transverse plates that make up the shell; the back plates are broad and smooth with ridged lines, the neck plates form a ruffled collar around the neck, and the head plate is a small cap with a wavy edge and two small rivet-like bumps at the front
parts.where: as part of the shell: largest plates over the mid-back and shoulders, smaller collar-like plates around the neck, and a cap-like plate on the crown between the ears

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged creature standing in right profile on a patch of pebbly ground. The body, head, fur, and tail are those of a gray wolf with thick shaggy gray and white fur, a pointed muzzle, amber eyes, upright ears, and a long bushy tail hanging down at the rear. The entire top of the animal from between the ears along the neck and back to above the tail is covered by a dark gray-black hard segmented shell with overlapping plates and scalloped side edges. The two hind legs end in furry wolf paws with small dark nails, while the two front legs end in large smooth black two-pronged pincers that touch the ground.
